stories.title: The NBA strips the Clippers of five first-round picks
stories.summary: After a yearlong probe into salary cap circumvention involving Kawhi Leonard, the NBA took five first-round picks from the Los Angeles Clippers, fined owner Steve Ballmer $30 million and handed out suspensions, including to Ballmer. Shams Charania's report got 124K likes, and fans tallied what Leonard had cost the franchise, from Shai Gilgeous-Alexander to 10 first-round picks.
